Walk-in-Interview
The Walk-In-Interview for appointing Guest Faculty to teach the subject of Law at UILS,
Hoshiarpur, for Even Semester (Academic Session 2022-23) as per advertisement notice for
appointment of Guest Faculty Law vide despatch no. 656/PUSSGRC dated 23.02.2023 was
uploaded on the campus as well as Panjab University, Chandigarh site also, will be held in
the office of DCDC department, Rajiv Gandhi Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh as per
the following schedule:
Date Subject Vacancies Time
13.04.2023
(Thursday)
Law 05 09:30 a.m.
NOTE: Those eligible candidates who have not applied upto 03.03.2023 are also allowed to
appear before selection committee for the above selection.
The applicants are required to fill the application form for Assistant Professor available on
Panjab University website (https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
Directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf) (Page 1 to
10).
All the eligible applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant
documents for verification along with the duly filled application form and attested copies of
all certificates/documents and passport size photographs with (04 set photocopy) on
13.04.2023.
(Minimum qualification s as per UGC norms).
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs 1000/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 25,000/- per month.
Note:
1. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates appearing for the Interview.
Sd/-
Director
PUSSGRC, Hoshiarpur
